name: PlexusOne REST API Guidelines Evaluation Rubric
description: House REST API style guide for PlexusOne products (DashForge, ActionForge, AgentForge, SystemForge, OmniNotebook) and the crossforge interop contract. Derived from the api-style-spec default profile with PlexusOne-specific rules for PRN resource references, authorization scopes, run resources, and streaming. Self-contained rather than relying on `extends` resolution (the api-style-spec loader treats `extends` as schema-only metadata, not inherited rules) — restated rules cite their source as `default PO-xxx`.

categories.name: General Guidelines
categories.description: Fundamental requirements for all PlexusOne APIs

categories.name: URL Design

options.label: Pass
criteria: All collection endpoints use plural nouns

options.label: Fail
criteria: Singular nouns used for collection segments

categories.evaluationPrompt: Check whether all collection endpoints use plural nouns for resource segments.

categories.name: HTTP Methods

options.label: Pass
criteria: Invocations are POSTs creating run resources
No verb-only path segments like /delete or /execute

categories.evaluationPrompt: Verify HTTP methods follow REST semantics and that invocation is modeled as creating a run sub-resource rather than verb paths.

categories.name: Error Handling

options.label: Pass
criteria: Error responses use application/problem+json with type/title/status/detail

categories.evaluationPrompt: Check that 4xx/5xx responses reference an RFC 9457 Problem Details schema (application/problem+json).

categories.name: Pagination
categories.evaluationPrompt: Check that list endpoints accept cursor/limit parameters and return an items array with nextCursor.

categories.name: Versioning & Compatibility
categories.description: API versioning, deprecation, and breaking-change policy

categories.name: Crossforge Interop
categories.description: PRN references, invocation, and run resources

options.label: Pass
criteria: PRN fields use the Prn name suffix

options.label: Fail
criteria: Bare foreign ids for cross-product references
Ad hoc URLs used as identifiers

categories.evaluationPrompt: Check that schema fields referencing resources in other PlexusOne products use prn:// URI values and Prn-suffixed field names rather than bare ids or ad hoc URLs.

categories.name: Streaming & Long-Running Operations
categories.description: SSE, WebSocket, and async run patterns

options.label: Pass
criteria: Runs are resources with GET polling

categories.evaluationPrompt: Check that long-running operations are exposed as run sub-resources returning 202 with id/prn/status, and that status enums use PENDING/RUNNING/SUCCEEDED/FAILED/CANCELLED/TIMED_OUT.
